questions.questionText: What's the most reliable fix for an infinite tool-calling loop?
options: Hope the model eventually stops on its own
Set an explicit maximum step count as a hard backstop, and fix the actual stop-condition signal the agent checks
Remove all tools from the agent
questions.correctAnswer: Set an explicit maximum step count as a hard backstop, and fix the actual stop-condition signal the agent checks
questions.explanation: A hard step limit guarantees termination regardless of the agent's own (possibly buggy) reasoning, and fixing the actual stop-condition check addresses the root cause rather than just capping the symptom.

questions.questionText: What's the more robust fix for a model wrapping requested JSON in conversational text?
options: Always crash the pipeline and alert a human immediately
Prefer the model's native structured-output/tool-calling mode, which constrains generation so wrapper text can't appear at all
Ask the user to manually reformat every response
There is no possible fix for this failure mode
questions.correctAnswer: Prefer the model's native structured-output/tool-calling mode, which constrains generation so wrapper text can't appear at all
questions.explanation: Structured output / tool calling (withStructuredOutput) constrains the model at generation time, which is more robust than defensively parsing free-form text after the fact, though defensive parsing is a reasonable fallback.

questions.questionText: What underlying context engineering technique fixes "context window collapse" in a multi-agent pipeline?
options: Passing every worker's full raw output forward unchanged
Summarizing or selectively passing forward only each worker's conclusion, and keeping the original question re-stated close to where final generation happens
Increasing the number of workers in the pipeline
questions.correctAnswer: Summarizing or selectively passing forward only each worker's conclusion, and keeping the original question re-stated close to where final generation happens
questions.explanation: This directly applies the context engineering lesson's selective-retrieval and attention-placement guidance to prevent the original question from getting buried under accumulated raw worker output.
